'''Fush Powerful BHBM''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 8 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 BHBM Fush DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a BHBM deck with big beats. Constructive comments are welcome.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

COMMENTS

This is primarily a beat-down deck, but with the opportunity to capture and turn Luke if he should appear. Just plain and solid.

SOME CARD CHOICES

- Why Mob.Points and not the combo? With so few locations I need the extra +1 when controlling. And I don't use any pullable effects.

- Aurra Sing: Great with Boba Fett, and her weapon is destiny 7.

- 3 Boba's? Hit'n run...

- Blizzard 4: For pulling Vader.

- Rise My Friend x2: If Luke comes along, I'll might as well bring him up and turn him.

- Stormtrooper Garrison: For defending Palpatine.
